reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited text supports it: Section 12.3 expressly records that Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment, and neither 7.1 (Fees fixed to the Order Form) nor 8.3 (capped renewal uplift) imposes any best-terms, price-matching, or third-party-comparison undertaking on Customer.

Consistent with the rule's redline guidance, no edit is proposed and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs; no counterparty comment is expected or given for a compliant finding.
Deterministic checks are empty, and the rationale correctly scopes out unrelated exclusivity/non-compete points as outside this rule, so no directional or completeness defect is present.
